'''David Crane''' won the [[1997 Borås Open]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm an Electronics Engineer for Motorola. I enjoy gaming and play with my sons. In fact, at the Kiffex 1 Regional, I finished second, my sons Billy (13 years) and Thomas (10 years) finished third and fourth. I was glad not to have to face either of them in the Final!"<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/crane.html David Crane], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427161043/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/crane.html Internet Archive]</ref>
